VERSION.value: github.com/freecores/round_robin_arbiter master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Round-robin arbitration: when several requesters compete for one shared resource, grant fairly in rotation so none starves; the arbiter is a small finite-state DECISION machine at the heart of buses, NoCs and schedulers

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: fair arbitration of a shared hardware resource

value.built_to: decide, each clock, which of several simultaneous requesters gets a shared resource, rotating priority so every requester is served and none is starved
value.pressure: more requesters than resources, arriving simultaneously; a fixed-priority scheme starves low-priority requesters under load
value.success_means: every requester eventually granted (no starvation), with bounded waiting, at one grant per cycle

value.pressure: resource contention: simultaneous competing requests for one grant
value.failure_condition: starvation: a requester never gets the resource; or a grant collision (two grants at once) corrupts the shared bus
